title: Hypertrophy Recovery focused Program
author: TheElderMuscle
desc:
This program is designed to get you big and strong over 18 weeks. Start on a weight where you can only manage 8 reps. Build the reps to 15 before increasing weight.

Sets dropped to 3 per exercise to incorporate more exercises per session. After warming up, go all out on the first two sets and then reduce the weight slightly for the last set.

Take 1-2 minutes rest per between sets. If this becomes easier increase to four sets per exercise
